name: GN-CL-3 protocluster field, GOODS-North (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the submillimeter galaxy GN-CL-3 in a distant protocluster near GOODS-North, seen by Hubble.
label: gnclsouth-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field hides GN-CL-3, a dusty, furiously star-forming galaxy in a protocluster, a city of galaxies still under construction far across the universe; another dusty galaxy, GN-CL-1, lies even farther back in the same view. Hubble looked to see whether their stars betray mergers or compact cores.

claims.text: The GNCL-SOUTH pointing contains GN-CL-3, a protocluster member, and also GN-CL-1 and GN-CL-4
GN-CL-3 lies at the protocluster redshift and GN-CL-1 lies farther away
Hubble program 16504 targets the two brightest submillimeter galaxies of a spectroscopically confirmed, massively star-forming protocluster in GOODS-North, to tell advanced mergers from compact cores
The protocluster region lies near GOODS-North, just outside the earlier HST/ACS and WFC3 footprints
